full_prompt_en: A square mixed-media monochrome image shows a pale woman's face emerging through torn, scratched, and partly transparent dark layers. The close crop fills the frame with her forehead, eyes, nose, and parted lips; the lower neck is swallowed by the black surface near the bottom edge. A near-black field occupies the far left and right margins, while mottled silver-gray areas run through the center. The left eye is clear and framed by a dark brow and heavy smoky shadow. The other eye appears farther back through a narrow vertical division, as if a strip of translucent material has been placed across the face. Her nose and lips remain recognizable, but the right half of the face is interrupted by angled pale shards and darker vertical stains. Across the upper edge, rough torn shapes obscure the hairline. Near the lower right, a large light diagonal strip rises beside the jaw, its ragged edges crossing the black background. Fine scratches, drip marks, and specks run both over the face and through the surrounding darkness, making the smooth skin feel embedded in a distressed surface. A few rusty brown flecks warm the nearly black-and-white palette at the sides without becoming a separate color field. The brightest light falls across the left forehead, cheek, nose, and lip, while the right side recedes behind layered shadow. The image has no open setting or readable text; the fragmented planes themselves form the background and obscure any physical place. The overall composition is tense and intimate, with a luminous face nearly filling the frame while torn geometry and grain break its continuity.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形混合媒介近单色画面呈现一张浅色女子面孔，从撕裂、划伤且部分透明的深色层中浮现。近距离裁切让额头、眼睛、鼻子和微张的唇占满画幅；下方颈部在底缘附近被黑色表面吞没。近黑色区域占据最左和最右边缘，斑驳银灰色从中央穿过。左眼清晰，深色眉毛与浓重烟熏般的阴影围住它。另一只眼睛通过狭窄的竖向分割出现在更深处，仿佛有一条半透明材料覆在脸上。鼻与唇仍可辨认，脸的右半部却被斜向浅色碎片和较深竖向污迹打断。上缘粗糙撕裂的形状遮住发际。右下附近，一道大的浅色斜条沿下颌升起，毛糙边缘横切黑色背景。细微划痕、滴落痕和颗粒同时越过面孔与周围黑暗，让平滑皮肤像嵌在受损表面中。两侧少量锈棕色斑点温暖了几乎黑白的色盘，却没有形成独立色域。最亮的光落在左侧额头、脸颊、鼻与唇上，右侧则退入层叠阴影。画面没有开阔场景或可读文字；碎裂平面自身构成背景，并遮住任何具体地点。整体构图紧张而亲密，明亮面孔几乎填满画幅，撕裂几何和颗粒打断了它的连续性。
style_prompt_en: The mixed-media image combines photographic grayscale modeling with torn-paper edges, translucent stains, scratched lines, and heavy black collage fields. The palette is almost monochrome, using pale silver, dirty gray, charcoal, and minute rusty brown flecks. Smooth luminous areas sit beside rough opaque patches, so the strongest contrast occurs where an intact volume meets a broken surface. Angled strips and vertical marks interrupt continuous shapes without erasing their underlying structure. Fine grain, drips, and abrasions accumulate unevenly, giving the surface a weathered physical presence. Light is selective and frontal across one side, then falls rapidly into overlapping darkness. The space is shallow and compressed by close cropping; depth appears through semi-transparent layers rather than distant perspective. The overall effect is haunting and tactile, with delicacy repeatedly cut by sharp, damaged geometry.
style_prompt_zh: 混合媒介画面将摄影式灰阶塑形与撕纸边缘、半透明污迹、划刻线条和厚重黑色拼贴区域结合。色盘几乎单色，由浅银、脏灰、炭黑与极少量锈棕斑点组成。平滑发亮区域紧贴粗糙不透明斑块，最强反差出现在完整体积碰到破损表面之处。斜向条片与竖向痕迹切断连续形状，却没有擦去下层结构。细颗粒、滴痕和磨损不均匀地积累，赋予表面风化的实体触感。光选择性地从正面照亮一侧，随后迅速落入叠置黑暗。近裁切压缩了浅空间；深度来自半透明层，而非远景透视。整体效果幽暗且可触，柔细部分不断被锐利、破损的几何结构截断。
theme_en: A pale face emerging through torn and scratched dark layers
theme_zh: 浅色面孔从撕裂、划伤的暗色层中浮现
name: Jarek Kubicki
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
